# Visual parity scoreboard

How close our committed TS render (**golden**) sits to the real **PyMOL** ray
reference, by the colour-aware metric in `apps/web/e2e/score.mjs` (mean of shape
coverage and foreground colour fidelity). Regenerate goldens with
`node apps/web/e2e/visual.e2e.mjs --update`, then `node scripts/parity-visual.mjs`.
View the scenes visually in the gallery: `node apps/web/e2e/gallery.mjs` →
`/gallery.html` on the front dev server.
